scope: Apple M4 synthetic one-layer attention, four threads and workers, three and four query heads per KV head, 1024 and 4096 visible positions
cases: Use identical BenchmarkSharedKVAttention and BenchmarkSharedKVFourHeads fixtures for both builds. Each process supplies two timings per path. FP32 serves as a timing control.
aggregation: Take the median of the two samples per process and path, divide candidate by reference in adjacent process pairs, and report the median of four pair ratios.
timing_gate: At 4096 positions, both FP16 shared paths must have median ratios at most 0.95 and at least three of four adjacent pairs faster. Retain all measurements.
numeric_gate: All 65536 half encodings match the previous converter's FP32 bits. Both KV formats pass the exact attention and single-row prefill tests. Verify the pinned FP16 Llama 3.2 3B ordinary-build trajectory at 128 and 1024 positions against the recorded FP16 reference.
